cases.service: three-way match exception review on one PO

requirements.text: PO 7781 ordered 500 units at 12.00 each. The receiving report shows 480 units received. The vendor invoice bills 500 units at 12.40 each, total 6,200. What is the exception, how much is supported for payment, and how should AP resolve it?

cases.service: design an invoice and payment approval workflow

requirements.text: We are a 40-person distributor on NetSuite processing about 600 vendor invoices a month. Right now our AP clerk enters bills and also releases the payment run. Design an approval matrix and payment approval workflow with proper controls.
Our vendor list is a mess. Can you give us a plan to clean it up?
